question: Which languages are spoken by only one country in republic governments?
reference_sql: SELECT T2.Language FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T1.GovernmentForm  =  "Republic" GROUP BY T2.Language HAVING COUNT(*)  =  1

final.sql:
SELECT cl.Language
FROM countrylanguage cl
JOIN country c ON cl.CountryCode = c.Code
WHERE c.GovernmentForm LIKE '%Republic%'
GROUP BY cl.Language
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.CountryCode) = 1
